set.descent_text: Parties descend by rappelling the route. The upper pitches have fixed belay stations that make the first rappels straightforward, but at the big bivouac ledge the rappel line leaves the climbing line and drops down the face to the right of the chimneys, on bolted anchors that start at the northeast end of the ledge and reach the top of the third pitch. Anchors on the headwall are worth noting on the way up, because the stations on the lower face are hard to find from above. Stay out of the chimney: ropes snag on every feature there and the descent becomes slow. From the top of the third pitch a further rappel reaches the top of the first.

review.notes: Descent by rappelling the route, the bolted line right of the chimneys from the bivy ledge, and the chimney snag hazard are on the MP page and the unabridged guide page; no approach text found, so approach omitted.
